gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.description: Replay the welcome tour to see what each part of LeadFlow AI does.

welcome.title: Welcome to LeadFlow AI
welcome.description: Let's take a quick 2-minute tour so you know exactly where everything lives before you dive in.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Your home base — a live snapshot of leads, campaigns, and recent activity across your whole workspace.
dashboard.limits: Available on every plan, including Free.
dashboard.tip: Check back here each morning to see what happened overnight.

crm.title: CRM
crm.description: Track every contact, company, deal, meeting, task, and note in one pipeline — from first contact to closed-won.
crm.limits: Full CRM & pipeline management is included from the Pro plan; Free and Starter can still manage contacts and companies.
crm.tip: Drag deals across pipeline stages as conversations progress.

leads.title: Leads
leads.description: Search for companies by country, industry, city, and keywords to build a targeted list of prospects worth reaching out to.
leads.limits: Free includes 50 lead searches / month, Starter 1,000, Pro 10,000, and Enterprise unlimited.
leads.tip: Start narrow — a tight filter like industry + city usually beats a broad search.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.description: Schedule and monitor multi-step email outreach sequences, with open, reply, and click tracking built in.
campaigns.limits: Free allows 1 active campaign, Starter 5, and Pro & Enterprise unlimited.
campaigns.tip: Start with a 2–3 step sequence — you can always add more steps later.

templates.title: Templates
templates.description: Save your best-performing emails as reusable templates so your whole team can send on-brand outreach fast.
templates.tip: Duplicate a template before editing it, so the original stays intact.

aiTools.title: AI Tools
aiTools.description: Generate outreach copy in seconds — emails, subject lines, headlines, and CTAs, tuned to each lead's website and industry.
aiTools.limits: AI email generation starts on the Starter plan; the full AI Tools suite unlocks on Pro.
aiTools.tip: Give the AI a specific goal, like "book a 15-minute call", for sharper copy.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.description: See open rate, reply rate, conversion rate, and revenue trends at a glance with clean, exportable reports.
analytics.limits: Available on every plan; exportable and revenue-by-plan reports are part of Pro and Enterprise.
analytics.tip: Compare campaigns side by side to see which subject lines actually get replies.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Get notified the moment a campaign sends, a lead replies, a deal changes stage, or a payment needs attention.
notifications.tip: Click any notification to jump straight to the related lead, deal, or invoice.

billing.title: Billing
billing.description: Manage your subscription, payment method, and invoices, and see exactly what's included in your current plan.
billing.limits: Free is $0/month, Starter $49/month, Pro $149/month, and Enterprise $499/month with custom limits.
billing.tip: You can upgrade or downgrade anytime from Settings → Subscription.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage your profile, security, workspace members, notification preferences, and API keys.
settings.limits: Available on every plan; the number of workspace members you can invite depends on your plan's seats.
settings.tip: Turn on strong security and invite your team here before you start sending campaigns.
